title: Porridge with apple and rhubarb compote

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oats, fresh fruit, hazelnuts, brown sugar and cinnamon are all plain home ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Apples, forced rhubarb, an orange, oats and hazelnuts are all everyday Tesco items in March.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only two saucepans and a knife, using simple simmering.

works.reason: 200g oats in 1.2 litres of water makes a loose but sound porridge for four, and 10 minutes softens the cubed apple and rhubarb into a compote.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes is enough to chop the nuts, cube the fruit and juice an orange, and the porridge can cook while the compote simmers, so 15 minutes of cooking holds up.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, names match their ids, and only water is added.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm porridge suits a chilly March morning, and the apples make up the bulk of the compote alongside early rhubarb.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oats, fruit and nuts with only a tablespoon of sugar make a filling, wholesome family breakfast.
